title: WaterColor 88 Vermilion Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Located in the beautiful Lake District of WaterColor- Screened-in porch with fireplace- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day.- Garage- 5 adult bikes- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Steps away from Western Lake, biking distance from the beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the WaterColor Beach Club. It features a main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Uncover the carefree charm of WaterColor at 88 Vermillion Way. Nestled in the lovely Lake District, with 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this 3-level coastal home comfortably accommodates 14 guests. Enjoy access to multiple community pools, pickleball courts, white sand beaches, and the fabulous WaterColor Beach Club. Guests will love the private pool, short walk to Western Lake, and being within biking distance from the beach!On the first floor of this stunning home, discover a refined, peaceful interior with tongue-and-groove beamed ceilings, hardwood floors, and natural fiber rugs. In the living space, sink into 2 plush sofas and 2 matching armchairs to unwind with a movie on the 65” Roku-equipped TV. Past the dining table for 8 and dry bar is a gourmet kitchen with a Wolf 6-burner stove, 2 ovens, 2 dishwashers, and a vast breakfast bar for 6. For convenience, hooks, a bench, and cubbies are adjacent to the utility room, which features an extra refrigerator and a stacked washer and dryer. When the warm weather calls, a sitting area, fireplace, TV, and overhead fan on the screened porch encourage lounging in the fresh air. Outside, recline on the shaded patio furniture, sip iced tea at the 6-seat outdoor table, or enjoy the pool and sitting spa.At bedtime, head to the second level to find the primary bedroom with a king bed and 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds—all 3 have private bathrooms and a Roku TV. The 2 guest bedrooms share a balcony with a cushioned porch swing, and there’s an office beside the primary bedroom.The third-level living area offers extra hangout space with a couch, 2 armchairs, and a TV. Sleeping accommodations include a guest bedroom with 2 queen beds, a bedroom with 2 twin beds and 2 twin trundles, and a twin Murphy bed in the living space.Get away to 88 Vermillion Way for a delightful WaterColor escape. Easily explore thanks to on-site parking, a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, and 5 complimentary adult bikes. Guests can use 2 beach access points—the first is at the WaterColor Beach Club, and the second is located on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):SECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds with 2 Twin Trundles, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Lounge/TV Room with Twin Murphy Bed.*The elevator is not available for guest use unless prior approval is obtained from the homeowner.*The living room fireplace is not for guest use.

This home is allotted 14 wristbands. - Located in the beautiful Lake District of WaterColor - Screened-in porch with fireplace - Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day. - Garage - 5 adult bikes - 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Steps away from Western Lake, biking distance from the beach - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the WaterColor Beach Club. It features a main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Uncover the carefree charm of WaterColor at 88 Vermillion Way. Nestled in the lovely Lake District, with 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this 3-level coastal home comfortably accommodates 14 guests. Enjoy access to multiple community pools, pickleball courts, white sand beaches, and the fabulous WaterColor Beach Club. Guests will love the private pool, short walk to Western Lake, and being within biking distance from the beach! On the first floor of this stunning home, discover a refined, peaceful interior with tongue-and-groove beamed ceilings, hardwood floors, and natural fiber rugs. In the living space, sink into 2 plush sofas and 2 matching armchairs to unwind with a movie on the 65” Roku-equipped TV. Past the dining table for 8 and dry bar is a gourmet kitchen with a Wolf 6-burner stove, 2 ovens, 2 dishwashers, and a vast breakfast bar for 6. For convenience, hooks, a bench, and cubbies are adjacent to the utility room, which features an extra refrigerator and a stacked washer and dryer. When the warm weather calls, a sitting area, fireplace, TV, and overhead fan on the screened porch encourage lounging in the fresh air. Outside, recline on the shaded patio furniture, sip iced tea at the 6-seat outdoor table, or enjoy the pool and sitting spa. At bedtime, head to the second level to find the primary bedroom with a king bed and 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds—all 3 have private bathrooms and a Roku TV. The 2 guest bedrooms share a balcony with a cushioned porch swing, and there’s an office beside the primary bedroom. The third-level living area offers extra hangout space with a couch, 2 armchairs, and a TV. Sleeping accommodations include a guest bedroom with 2 queen beds, a bedroom with 2 twin beds and 2 twin trundles, and a twin Murphy bed in the living space. Get away to 88 Vermillion Way for a delightful WaterColor escape. Easily explore thanks to on-site parking, a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, and 5 complimentary adult bikes. Guests can use 2 beach access points—the first is at the WaterColor Beach Club, and the second is located on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!
